remarks: Discover the essence of sophisticated living at Cranberry Court, a 4-unit brick and clapboard complex opposite Mead Park. Inside, a charming living room with a fireplace and bay window seamlessly connects to the dining area, offering access to a terrace with Mead Park views. A renovated kitchen with quartz countertops complements the dining area and front entry hall, creating a perfect space for culinary artistry. The spacious primary bedroom includes a dressing room and updated bath. A second bedroom, study, and additional updated bath provide ample space for guests and work. Built by Hobbs, the property features 9-foot ceilings, basement storage, and a detached garage. A short distance from the village and train station, Cranberry Court offers tranquility and convenience.
